description: Problem-to-drill data bank. Each entry maps a detectable form issue to the camera angle it's measured from, the pose metric used to detect it, its likely cause, and a corrective drill.

problems.name: Flying Elbow
problems.metric: Elbow's horizontal distance from the shoulder-hip vertical line at set point/release
problems.cause: Shooting thumb positioned under the ball pointing straight left instead of at roughly a 45 degree angle
problems.drill: Wall/body drill: shoot with the elbow lightly brushing the torso to groove 'elbow under, not out'.

problems.name: Thumbing the Ball
problems.metric: Guide-hand wrist movement/rotation in the frames immediately before release (proxy signal, since individual fingers are not tracked)
problems.cause: Guide hand stays on the ball too long and adds force instead of just balancing it
problems.drill: Guide-hand-off drill: hold the guide hand about 1 inch off the ball through the entire motion.

problems.name: Two-Motion Shot / Hitch
problems.metric: Elbow-angle (or wrist-height) time series across the shot. One-motion shows a smooth continuous curve from dip to release; two-motion shows a pause or plateau at the set point.
problems.cause: Rushing the load, or a disconnect between leg drive timing and arm timing
problems.drill: Close-range form shooting (one-hand, then one-hand-plus-guide) until the motion is automatic before backing up to game range.

problems.name: Inconsistent Release Point / Arc
problems.metric: Variance in release angle and release height across the 5 recorded reps
problems.cause: Elbow extension or release timing changes from shot to shot
problems.drill: One-armed shooting drill to isolate the shooting arm and groove a repeatable release.

problems.name: Base / Balance Issues
problems.metric: Foot width vs. shoulder width; landing-position drift relative to the starting spot
problems.cause: Feet too narrow or too wide, or drifting on the landing
problems.drill: Footwork drills alternating a two-foot hop and a 1-2 step, done close to the rim with a balance focus.

problems.name: Guide Hand Timing
problems.metric: Frame where the guide hand separates from the ball, relative to the release frame
problems.cause: Guide hand leaves too early (loses ball control) or too late (interferes with release)
problems.drill: Same guide-hand-off drill, cued so the hand leaves exactly as the shooting arm extends, not before or during.

problems.name: Knee Bend / Leg Drive
problems.metric: Knee angle at load vs. at release, and whether leg extension timing lines up with arm extension
problems.drill: Form shooting with an exaggerated pause at the dip, to feel the legs loading before the arm fires.
